From: Lisa Monelli <info@myvilla.la>

Subject: One thought after your Malibu sinkhole story

Hi Canyon News team,

(Writing to the Canyon News newsroom rather than Sharon directly — we couldn't locate a direct contact. Feel free to forward if it's a better fit for them or the desk.)

Read your report on the Sea Level Drive collapse in Malibu. You kept the focus where it belongs, on the ground itself, while most pickups of the story stayed on the celebrity angle.

A quick hello from our side: at My Villa, we bring European construction resilience and the Italian way of living to homes in Los Angeles, designed in exposed reinforced concrete, cemento a vista.

One angle your piece sparked: in Europe, building for the site and for the long term has been default practice for generations, well before resilience became a topic here. That cultural lag feels like the real story behind incidents like this one.

Would you be interested in receiving more material on what we are doing, or in setting up a short call with our founder Paolo?

Best,
Lisa Monelli
My Villa Media Team
info@myvilla.la · myvilla.la
